name: record_review
description: Record a graded attempt in the spaced-repetition schedule. Call once per question after check_answer. Returns the rating and when the question is next due.

answer.description: The learner's answer as given: an option letter, letters such as A,C for multi-select, true or false, or their words.

correct.description: Whether the answer was correct: check_answer's result, or your own judgement when it returned null.
